mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_document_tasks(id,user_id,session_id,resource_id,request_key,status,state_json) VALUES (#{row.id},#{row.userId},#{row.sessionId},#{row.resourceId},#{row.requestKey},#{row.status},#{row.stateJson}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,session_id,request_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_document_tasks WHERE user_id=#{user} AND session_id=#{session} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

UPDATE chat_document_tasks SET lease_until=NOW()+INTERVAL '12 minutes' WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM chat_document_tasks WHERE (status IN ('PARSING','QUEUED','OCR_RUNNING','VERIFYING','GENERATING') OR status IN ('RECOGNIZED','GOOD','LOW','UNSUPPORTED','FAILED','VERIFIED','CONFIRMED') AND state_json::jsonb->>'resumeStatus' IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('PARSING','QUEUED','OCR_RUNNING','VERIFYING','GENERATING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING *
SELECT user_message_id FROM agent_runs WHERE user_id=#{user} AND session_id=#{session} AND status='RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM agent_runs WHERE id=#{runId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_document_tasks SET status='QUEUED', state_json=jsonb_set(jsonb_set(state_json::jsonb,'{status}','"QUEUED"'::jsonb),'{detail}','""'::jsonb)::text, revision=revision+1, lease_until=NULL, updated_at=NOW() WHERE status IN ('CLOUD_UNAVAILABLE','NEEDS_EXTERNAL_CONSENT') AND COALESCE(state_json::jsonb->>'continuationCancelled','false')='false'
